summary: Complete independent source review of all 228 Chinese units, 41 temporal/hint checks, and 19 people. Explicit Qing and late-Qing regnal-year notices support the retained year-level attestations. Nine earlier people are named only in undated retrospective, bibliographic, or allusive passages; their imported point dates, dynasty-wide intervals, or legendary label cannot be approved without source-specific research. The report preserves complete coverage and research holds; it makes no source or extraction edit.

findings.problem: Nine people have date claims or active hints that are not established by the quoted Chinese units. The passages provide undated historical allusions, a bibliographic citation, or a broad polity label; they do not justify the asserted Western point dates, Qin First Emperor reign interval, Northern Wei-wide Cui Ting interval, or Robber Zhi legendary-antiquity hint.
findings.action: Obtain and pin source-specific independent chronology for each named event or allusion, then replace each claim with only the supported date/context; remove any date or hint that remains unsupported. Submit the repaired extraction for a fresh independent audit.
